errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the x-coordinates of the plotted data points. The first five points are correctly identified at x-values of 1, 3, 5, 7, and 9, but the last data point is located at x=10, not x=11, as it aligns with the '10' tick mark on the x-axis.
In the description of the 'mmsd' series, the final data point is said to be at an x-value of 11. The plot shows this point is aligned with the x-axis tick mark for 10.
In the description of the 'mmsd2' series, the final data point is said to be at an x-value of 11. The plot shows this point is aligned with the x-axis tick mark for 10.
